name: social-reel
title: Social reel
summary: A 15-to-45-second vertical film for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, with captions burned in by Remotion in the brand's font.
use_when: A single idea for a vertical feed. It is the default for autonomous films.

pace.note: Tighter than a brand film's placement: every half second of air is a real share of a 30-second reel.

beats.name: hook
beats.job: The reason to stay, inside the first two seconds, readable with the sound off.

beats.name: idea
beats.job: One idea, shown: a reel is a single thought, not a trailer for one.

beats.name: payoff
beats.job: The turn or the answer the hook promised.

beats.name: end
beats.job: A frame that loops cleanly back to the start, or one clear next step.

rules: Every word the voice says is on screen as a burned-in caption, inside every channel's safe zone.
Put the subject in the middle band: the platforms cover the top, the bottom and the right-hand buttons.

captions.position: lower middle, above the bottom 35% the platforms keep for their own captions and buttons

budget.note: Generation only when it's allowed and adds something. About 1% of a Pro month.

notes: The autonomous default (plan §7): an autonomous film that names no format is a 15-45 second 9:16 reel.
A reel made from scratch runs at 30 fps. A reel derived from a 16:9 film keeps its parent's clock, so every reused timing stays frame-exact.
A social channel, so it can take the fast route: fewer motion-blur samples and an ffmpeg master.
The end is a tenth of the reel (its structure's end beat): 1.5 s at the shortest, 15 s, so the last 1.5 s hold perfectly still (qa's end_hold); the films' 3 s end card is for longer films.
